visualReview.scope: Completed stadium exterior and visible football bowl.
visualReview.notes: All sixteen current portable and sixteen shared frames inspected, including full-size concourse, catwalk, roof-joint and placement views. Corrected concourse slabs and continuous columns close the visible gaps. Forty-six stayed consoles, vaulted canopy, maintenance ladders, catwalk underside, floodlights, three blue/yellow seating tiers, west screen and six individual ramps are coherent.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Metric membrane, concrete and painted metal are coherent in near and distant shared-surface frames. Local glazing, chairs and pitch keep their portable colors. Sky-PMREM geographic rendering and unload assertions pass. Published42mm roof tension rods are physically authored and may alias at distant viewpoints. Current viewer renders confirm the updated shared membrane material graphs in the existing geographic placement.

geographicReview.notes: Exact mapped pitch axis and actual stadium body align with the north-up outline; main facade screen is west. The incorrect wide estate footprint was retained as rejected evidence. Six mapped elevated approach ramps join the terrace; nativeY0 is outer ground/pitch contact.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed published exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Resident club, executed structural engineer and tension-rod manufacturer support the individual architecture and major dimensions. Console sections, chair inventory, local ramp grades, membrane camber and panel distribution remain photograph-based reconstruction; no event graphics or enclosed service rooms are included.

sharedHelperAdoption.change: Adopts commit 730813689 (2026-10-26): the shared stadium-models.mjs curve() helper, used for this stadium's rails, ring cables and frames, switched from one tube() per segment to a continuous tubePath() with shared miter rings and caps only at open ends. That removed overlapping segment caps and seams at every joint; nothing else in the model changed. The source pin had stayed at the pre-change output, which the build has not produced since that commit.
sharedHelperAdoption.evidence: The shared helper is not one of this model's listed recipes, so its input hash did not move while its output did. Regenerating with only that helper reverted reproduced the previous source pin exactly. Portable and shared-surface frames were recaptured from the current model and inspected; the existing review statuses and notes are retained.
